findings.summary: Recorded test output predates Phase 4 test additions; 14 new tests are absent from the evidence
findings.detail: The captured final_test_stdout.txt shows only 2 tests for hvpn-common (config_default_obfs_profile, config_round_trip_from_toml) and 5 for hvpn-transport (grpc_frame_round_trip, strip_grpc_frame_too_short, strip_grpc_frame_truncated, transport_config_construction, transport_config_with_cert_override). Phase 4 adds 9 tests in crates/hvpn-common/src/config.rs (all test_config_validate_* variants), 2 in crates/hvpn-transport/src/websocket.rs (test_cert_pin_rejects_wrong_cert, test_cert_pin_empty_falls_back_to_webpki), and 3 in crates/hvpn-common/src/audit.rs (audit_event_serializes_to_json, audit_logger_stderr_does_not_panic, current_timestamp_is_reasonable). None appear in the recorded output, meaning the evidence does not satisfy review criterion 2.
findings.consequence: It is unverifiable from the supplied evidence whether the 14 new Phase 4 tests compile and pass. A fresh cargo test --workspace run is required.
findings.correction: Re-run 'cargo test --workspace' after all Phase 4 source edits are complete and replace final_test_stdout.txt with the new output showing all test_config_validate_*, test_cert_pin_*, and audit_* tests passing.
